description.value: The study measured insula cortical thickness in young adult smokers and nonsmokers and examined associations with cigarette exposure, dependence, and craving.

spans.text: This study provides evidence that cigarette exposure, dependence, and craving are related to thickness of the insula in emergent adults with relatively little smoking experience.
